sections.title: Hover hint parts
sections.what: Creates the provider, the root, the trigger and the hint box. The hint box draws above the page with a small gap and animation.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the usual tooltip setup.
sections.watch_out: The provider must wrap any tooltip, or the hints will not work.

summary: Small hint text that appears when the user hovers over or focuses a control.
purpose: Explains a button or icon without using permanent screen space.
why: Likely reason: a standard hover hint built on the Radix tooltip library and styled to match the app. Otherwise reason not stated in the code.
how: The provider sets shared timing for all tooltips. The root holds the open or closed state. The trigger is the element that opens the hint. The content draws the hint box in a portal, which places it above the page, with a small gap and fade or zoom animations.
inputs: Hint content passed as children, an optional sideOffset gap, and standard tooltip settings.
outputs: A small dark hint box near the element that triggered it.
risks: Hover hints do not appear on touch screens. Part of the styling text is cut off in the material available.
debug: If no hint appears, check that TooltipProvider wraps the screen and the trigger uses TooltipTrigger. If the hint is clipped, check the z-index and overflow styling.
